configuration: GCC15.2 and Clang21.1.8 C++23; checked/skip default/native O2 and checked/skip default O1 ASan+UBSan; Slope also all with SIRKIT_FORCE_STANDARD_ARITHMETIC; CPU8; ASAN detect_leaks=0

reference.method: Independent bounded-integer DP under hinges, abs, shift/interval-min, prefix/suffix-min and function addition. Guard region600 covers120 shifts of at most3; central evaluations[-80,80] and finite endpoints within400 compared. Fullint64 boundaries also checked directly using128bit references.
reference.large_case: Extreme int64 coordinates, normalized-key/offset/minimum/difference overflow; optional infinity endpoints.

exceptions.per_configuration: 27 allocation failures and7 arithmetic overflow paths
exceptions.replacement_allocator: Fixture allocator functions noinline with volatile counters prevent allocation coalescing/optimization from invalidating lifetime accounting. Test-only allocation replacements; normal sources have no raw allocation.
exceptions.guarantee: All operation failures preserve function; capacity may change. Regular updates precompute and reserve, merge uses copy.

drivers.method: Pinned official samples plus120 independently generated valid random inputs per configuration. Expected values by sequential array or all candidate median costs.
